A nurse in Pahadishareef was allegedly raped and strangled; police arrested a bike mechanic in connection with the rape-murder investigation.
A 28-year-old woman alleged that her stepfather physically assaulted and sexually assaulted her at home; police registered a case and began searching for him.
A 23-year-old woman was allegedly shot in the chest by a man who had been pressuring her to marry him; police began searching for the accused.
A 21-year-old woman alleged that she was abducted, held for four days and raped; police registered a case and arrested the accused.

A 20-year-old man was arrested for allegedly kidnapping, sexually assaulting and repeatedly attacking a Class 12 girl whom he had befriended on Instagram.
